comparison.objective: Rinse teeth, evacuate modeled water, and return two tools; candidate performs dry precision bearing service.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests timed bimanual tool trajectories, coverage, suction placement, and cleanup. Candidate tests rigid end-face alignment, force-limited sliding, and containment of free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores wet coverage, recovery, spill/volume limits, tool return, release, and settling. Candidate scores complete block transfer and intact rolling-element support without loss, contamination, impact, or inclination.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and outcomes—fluid coverage/evacuation versus supported bearing transfer—are materially different.
